data.explanation: This letter confirms your registration for the summer program and asks for two forms — a signed code of conduct and an emergency contact form — by the stated date. Without both, the school will not confirm your room. Sign and send both documents to the Summer School Office as soon as possible. Note that today's date is well after the 5 June 2026 deadline stated in the letter, so if you have not sent these yet, contact the school directly to check whether your registration and room are still valid.
